name: Anchovy fish sauce
summary: A straight anchovy fish sauce, fermented in the rainy months when the Sê San catch will not dry.
origin: Nguyễn Văn Triều, a Sê San fishing-village resident quoted by the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism on 22 July 2022.
howToEat: Ferment the anchovy when the rain stops the drying. The article calls the result a straight anchovy sauce.
priceBand: The 22 July 2022 article quotes 80,000 VND a litre.
seoDescription: Straight anchovy fish sauce, fermented from Sê San fish in the rains. A 2022 quote is 80,000 VND a litre.
